verdict: REJECTED as a strategy change (does NOT increase risk-adjusted profit). Saved as research.
why: Per-trade the stable-carry score (funding / trailing funding-vol) DOES separate good from bad: top quintile step-Sharpe 0.254 vs 0.046 bottom, smallest tail (-29 bps vs -655 bps).
But scaling PORTFOLIO leverage by it concentrates capital into fewer coins -> sacrifices the diversification that produces the ~10 Sharpe / -0.3% DD, and raises turnover cost 19%->50%.
Raw 'more leverage on high funding' is worst: highest funding quintile worst-case -655 bps.
conclusion: Uniform leverage on the equal-weight book dominates per-trade conviction leverage (higher Sharpe AND >= return). Keep equal-weight; dial return with uniform leverage.
